question: Our school's girls volleyball team has 14 players, including a set of 3 triplets: Alicia, Amanda, and Anna.  In how many ways can we choose 6 starters if all three triplets are in the starting lineup?
solution:
The three triplets already occupy 3 of the 6 starting spots. Choose the remaining 6 − 3 = 3 starters from the 14 − 3 = 11 non-triplets. Since order does not matter, the count is C(11,3) = (11·10·9)/(3·2·1) = 165.
Final answer: 165
